tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.subtitle: How official battles are scored, common formats, and where to compete.
tournaments.scoringIntro: A Beyblade X match is a race to 4 points — you score by how you win each round:
tournaments.overDesc: You knock the opponent out of the stadium.
tournaments.burstDesc: You break the opponent apart mid-battle.
tournaments.xtremeDesc: You blast the opponent out through the Xtreme Zone.
tournaments.winCondition: First blader to 4 points takes the match.
tournaments.f1Desc: Classic knockout brackets — lose once (or twice) and you're out. The standard for most Challonge events.
tournaments.f2Desc: Everyone plays a fixed number of rounds against similarly-scored opponents; top finishers advance to a final bracket.
tournaments.f3Desc: Bring a deck of 3 combos with no repeated parts. The winner keeps their Bey on the stadium; take all three rounds to win.
tournaments.hostIntro: Host a simple bracket, pick a format, and let players join the lineup.
tournaments.hostGuideIntro: Use this setup before publishing so players understand the event, BEYLIVE has the right scoring rules, and the bracket can advance cleanly.
tournaments.hostGuideBasicsBody: Name, state, venue, and start time become the public event card and share link.
tournaments.hostGuideScoringBody: Max players controls joined and waitlisted spots. Default target score is the normal first-to value for matches.
tournaments.hostGuideFormatBody: Pick the preset that matches the event flow first. BEYLIVE uses this preset when it creates matches.
tournaments.hostGuideCustomizeBody: Enable customization only when the preset needs a different stage plan, top cut, round count, or scoring target.
tournaments.hostFieldNameHelp: Use a clear event name that players will recognise in links, lists, and podium cards.
tournaments.hostFieldCityHelp: Choose the Malaysian state where players should search for the event.
tournaments.hostFieldVenueHelp: Enter the shop, mall, hall, or exact meeting point.
tournaments.hostFieldStartsAtHelp: Set the real check-in or start time. Upcoming and past tabs are sorted from this.
tournaments.hostFieldMaxPlayersHelp: Joined players fill this limit first; extra players become waitlisted.
tournaments.hostFieldTargetScoreHelp: Sets the default first-to score. Some final stages may use a higher score automatically.
tournaments.hostFieldFormatHelp: Controls pairing, elimination, ranking, and how BEYLIVE advances the event.
tournaments.hostFieldNoteHelp: Add short rules, fee notes, prizes, check-in instructions, or format reminders.
tournaments.hostFormatGuideIntro: Choose the format by how many battles you can run and how strict the elimination should be.
tournaments.hostCustomizeReferenceBody: A custom plan records the intended stages for hosts and players. Supported automation fields include group-stage Groups and Advance, plus free-for-all Advance.
tournaments.hostCustomizeStageTypeHelp: The kind of stage: pool, Swiss, knockout, free-for-all, leaderboard, or finals.
tournaments.hostCustomizeEntrantsHelp: How many players should enter that stage.
tournaments.hostCustomizeAdvanceHelp: How many players move from this stage into the next stage.
tournaments.hostCustomizeGroupsRoundsHelp: Groups split players into pools. Rounds sets fixed Swiss or league rounds.
tournaments.hostCustomizeTargetScoreHelp: The first-to score for that stage when hosts want a different scoring target.
tournaments.hostCustomizeSeedingHelp: Seeded follows ranking or signup order, random shuffles, and manual means the host controls placement.
tournaments.loginToHost: Log in to host or join
tournaments.hostFormIntro: Fill in the tournament details below. Open the host guide only when you need setup help.
tournaments.hostFormatSingleDesc: Lose once and you are out.
tournaments.hostFormatDoubleDesc: Lose twice and you are out.
tournaments.hostFormatSwissDesc: Pair players with similar scores each round.
tournaments.hostFormatFreeForAllDesc: Many players per match, winners advance.
tournaments.hostFormatLeaderboardDesc: Rank players by points or results.
tournaments.hostFormatPartnerDesc: Random 2-blader teams drawn on a wheel, league rounds, then title and consolation playoffs.
tournaments.hostFormatGroupStageDesc: Split players into pools, run round robin in each pool, then advance the top cut to knockout.
tournaments.formatCustomizeDesc: Stage plan, advancement, scoring, and placement options.

about.title: About SPINDEX
about.p1: SPINDEX is built and maintained by SPINDEX Malaysia, a team of Beyblade X bladers and collectors.
about.p2: The goal: give bladers everywhere — in English and Chinese — one clean place to study every part, theory-craft combos, follow the competitive meta, and find people to battle.
about.sig: See you in the stadium. — SPINDEX Malaysia
